stem:
Observe the given figure carefully.

The figure shows a dry test tube held by a test tube holder and heated over a burner; the test tube contains blue copper sulphate crystals (\(\text{CuSO}_4 \cdot 5\text{H}_2\text{O}\)).

Which of the following observations are correct?
1. A white coloured residue is left behind in the test tube.
2. Water droplets are observed on the upper cooler part of the test tube.
3. On adding water to the residue, the colour changes to green.
